120761.en: How is it that a rogue cultivator like you could know {name|C}, the {post|C} of my sect {school|C}?
120761.ch: 你作为散修是如何认识我{school|C}{post|C}的{name|C}的？

120762.en: I'd never have imagined that a rogue cultivator like you would know {name|C}, the {post|C} of my sect {school|C}!
120762.ch: 你一名散修却与我{school|C}{post|C}的{name|C}的有旧，真叫人意想不到！

120780.en: So you're a rogue cultivator like me then. I hope we'll be able to enter sects together and be each other's shields.
120780.ch: 原来你也和我一样是一名散修，希望日后我们都可以加入宗门得个庇荫。

120781.en: I see your life as a rogue cultivator is free and easy. You seem to resent the control of sects as much as I do.
120781.ch: 我看阁下作为一名散修潇洒自在，想必与我一般都不爱受宗门摆布。

120782.en: As a fellow rogue cultivator, I can't help but feel great veneration for you, free and unrestrained as you are from sects.
120782.ch: 阁下潇洒不羁，不爱受宗门管辖，让同为散修的我肃然起敬啊！

120800.en: That I, a fellow rogue cultivator, am inferior in capability to you does indeed cause me great shame.
120800.ch: 同为散修，修为上却比不上你，这总叫我好生羞愧。

120801.en: Might you impart your knowledge of cultivation to me?
120801.ch: 能请教你修炼的心得么？

120802.en: As a rogue cultivator, you would be a great model for me to imitate in my studies.
120802.ch: 作为散修，你真乃我效法学习的榜样！

120820.en: Rogue cultivators value their own insight, but if you should ever run into difficulty, be sure I will offer my help.
120820.ch: 散修重在自悟，不过你若遇有难处，我们亦不妨互相印证。

120821.en: A difficult bottleneck is no reason to feel discouraged. I've been through such a predicament. This is just the rogue cultivator life.
120821.ch: 瓶颈无法突破不要气馁，我也曾经历你的困境，这是散修的无奈啊。

120822.en: I have no doubt that with enough perseverance, even a rogue cultivator can surpass the abilities of a sect disciple.
120822.ch: 我相信，若是持之以恒，即便是散修也不难超越宗门弟子！

120840.en: We're still rogue cultivators, and my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has had considerable luck, even joining {school|C} and becoming their {post|C}.
120840.ch: 你我还是散修，而我{relation|C|B}{name|C}造化不错，竟然进入{school|C}成为{post|C}。

120841.en: I do envy my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, for having the good fortune to get into {school|C} and the even better fortune to become the {post|C} there.
120841.ch: 说起来真是羡慕我{relation|C|B}{name|C}，竟得了机缘进入{school|C}并一路青云直上成为{post|C}。

120842.en: Even now, you and I are still rogue cultivators, and my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has enrolled at {school|C} and risen to {post|C} there.
120842.ch: 时至今日，你我仍是一介散修，而我{relation|C|B}{name|C}却已进入{school|C}并跻身{post|C}之位。

120860.en: You and I are both rogue cultivators, but you ought to befriend more people from sects. Look at me. Several of my friends have become sect disciples.
120860.ch: 你我同为散修，但你要多认识宗门朋友，像我就有多名朋友被宗门收为弟子。

120861.en: My sect friends have provided me with many benefits, and made my path as a rogue cultivator a far less stressful one.
120861.ch: 我的宗门朋友总给我带来许多好处，让我散修之路少去很多波折。

120862.en: The path of a rogue cultivator is no easy one. Having more friends from {school|C} has meant more helping hands for me.
120862.ch: 散修之路十分艰难，多得{school|C}的好友，总是提携于我。

120880.en: On the grounds of one's character, I appreciate you considerably.
120880.ch: 单以人品而言，我对阁下倒是颇为赞赏。

120881.en: Your cultivation knowledge are indeed exceptional.
120881.ch: 阁下修为道法确实了得。

120882.en: What say we put this all behind us?
120882.ch: 与我化干戈为玉帛，如何？

120900.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, is the {school|C} {post|C}. Should any conflict arise in future, I will be sure to appeal to {gender1|C} sense of compassion.
120900.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}是{school|C}的{post|C}，若有有朝一日生出矛盾，我会劝{gender|C}手下留情。

120901.en: I have no quarrel with you, but my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, being the {school|C} {post|C}, may come into conflict with you when the time comes, I'm afraid.
120901.ch: 我对你并无恶感，但在下{relation|C|B}{name|C}身居{school|C}{post|C}之位，只怕到时他会对你出手。

120902.en: {call|B|A}, even with us at opposite standpoints, I admire you greatly. As such, I will make a recommendation for you to visit my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, the {school|C} {post|C}.
120902.ch: {call|B|A}，你我立场不同，但我对你却十分佩服。因此想引荐你去见在下在{school|C}任{post|C}的{relation|C|B}{name|C}。

120920.en: It has been some time, and I see your skills have vastly improved, indeed leaving me in the dust.
120920.ch: 多日未见，你的修为似乎又更高了，真叫人望尘莫及啊。

120921.en: Friend, am I right in guessing certain elixirs have contributed to your cultivation progress?
120921.ch: 朋友，你是不是吃了什么灵丹妙药以致修为增长迅速。

120922.en: {call|B|A}, would you let me in on your cultivation secrets?

120942.en: {call|B|A}, I have learned much from my recent cultivation. Perhaps we could have a little exchange.
120942.ch: {call|B|A}，最近我修炼颇有心得，我们或能探讨一二。

120960.en: My studies seem to have surpassed yours at present, but I have only luck to thank. You will in time greatly surpass me.
120960.ch: 眼下我修为较你为高，不过是机缘所致，总有一日，你会比我更为强大。

120961.en: My studies are far from adequate. All you need do is continue to break through, and you'll soon reach a higher realm than mine.
120961.ch: 我的修为并不足道，只要你勤奋突破，迟早要比我境界高。

120962.en: As a {relation|A|B}, I hope you won't forget me if we meet in future!
120962.ch: 既为{relation|A|B}，以后若有奇遇，可不要忘了我！

120963.en: {relation|A|B}, I will have to rely on you in the future!

120964.en: {relation|A|B}, your studies are already in a league of their own. I hope you won't forget me if one day you make a name for yourself!
120964.ch: {relation|A|B}，你现在修为已经不俗，相信日后定会闯出名堂，到时可不要忘了我！

120980.en: {relation|A|B}, how goes your great journey to success?

120981.en: If ever you run into trouble, feel free to tell your {relation|A|B}, and I'll do whatever I can to help.
120981.ch: 日后若有难处，只管告诉{relation|A|B}，我一定尽力帮助。

120982.en: You are my {relation|A|B} today, and you will be my {relation|A|B} wherever you go, so I'll do all I can to make sure your path is one free of trouble!
120982.ch: 一日是{relation|A|B}，一世是{relation|A|B}，我一定会保你前路平平安安！

121000.en: To attain great talent and impart it to others is the dream of a teacher.
121000.ch: 得天下英才而教之，正是为师所愿。

121001.en: My teaching efforts have been strenuous, but not in vain when I have students to be proud of.
121001.ch: 不枉为师苦心传授道法，终于得此佳弟子。

121002.en: How have you gotten this good? Haha, you make your teacher feel old, you do.
121002.ch: 你修为竟到此地步了？为师老了，为师老了，哈哈。

121020.en: Keep up your cultivation or else you'll fall behind!
121020.ch: 快快修炼，否则便要落下进境！

121021.en: The way of cultivation is a matter only of diligence. Do not forget this, young disciple.
121021.ch: 修炼道法，无非一个勤字。徒儿，你要好好谨记。

121022.en: I hope one day to be surpassed by you.
121022.ch: 师父希望徒儿你有朝一日超越为师。

121040.en: How can I break through my realm to be as great as you, Master?
121040.ch: 请教师父，如何才能突破境界变得跟师父一样厉害！

121041.en: I wish to become like you one day, Master.
121041.ch: 徒儿想成为师父一般的人物，叱咤八荒。

121042.en: I don't know when I'll be ready to learn your unique special skills, Master.
121042.ch: 不知徒儿何时才配学习师父的独门绝技？

121060.en: I may have walked further on the immortal path, but I will never forget your teachings, Master!
121060.ch: 今日修为虽已经超越师父，但徒弟总会记住师父往日教诲的！

121061.en: After all, where would I be if not for you, Master, exhausting yourself to train me?
121061.ch: 如果不是有师父的倾囊相授，哪有徒弟今时今日的修为境界？

121062.en: You'd better cultivate more yourself, Master, or you might fall behind me.
121062.ch: 师父，你要努力修炼，否则便要远远落后于徒儿了。

121080.en: {call|B|A}, seeking immortality has been but a means to stay by your side.
121080.ch: {call|B|A}，修仙长生不过为了跟你永远厮守在一起。

121081.en: Reading through these books, I see only your name in the words.
121081.ch: 读遍道书，才发现书中全是您的名字。

121082.en: {call|B|A}, if your time in this world ever runs out, you can be sure mine will not last a moment longer.
121082.ch: {call|B|A}，若你寿元殆尽，我绝不比你多活片刻。

121100.en: I wish only for you, not for the immortal path. But for you, you seek the path. That is why you've surpassed me, is that so?
121100.ch: 我眼中只有你，没有道法，可你眼中还有道法，所以修为才较我为高，对不对？

121101.en: You've stolen my heart, interfered with my cultivation!
121101.ch: 你害我陷于情爱，耽误修炼！

121102.en: I cannot but ask which you value more: cultivation or me?
121102.ch: 敢问修炼与我，哪个重要？

121103.en: You listen here. All the work I've put into cultivation has been to protect you should the need arise!
121103.ch: 你可知道，我这样努力修炼，其实就是为了日后遇到危难时保护你啊！

121104.en: What an idiot you've been. You let your love for me get in your own way!
121104.ch: 真是一个痴人，因为爱我，你都把自己耽误了。

121105.en: You must have hit some kind of stumbling block in your cultivation, right? I've already surpassed you.
121105.ch: 最近可是修炼上遇有什么疑难？你的进境都已被我超过了。

121120.en: True. For all the time I've spent buried in scriptures, all I think about are your features.
121120.ch: 唉，眼里虽是万言道书，心中偏偏全是你的眉梢眼角。

121121.en: You see the art of immortality, mystic realms, rare artifacts, but I only see you.
121121.ch: 你的眼中有道法仙术，有洞府名窟，有珍奇法宝，可我的眼中却只有你。

121122.en: Cultivation has no limits, so too do my feelings for you!
121122.ch: 修炼没有尽头，我对你的情爱也是！

121140.en: Meeting you is my greatest fortune. Being with you has rewritten my destiny!
121140.ch: 遇见你，是我最好的气运，跟你在一起，就是我的逆天改命！

121141.en: Our love is unbreakable. If you ever run into problems, be sure to let me know.
121141.ch: 你我之间夫妻情深，若是修炼上出现问题，一定要告诉我。

121142.en: I feared love impeding your cultivation, but it would not do to not pay your love heed! I can't just stand by and watch as you fall behind me!
121142.ch: 曾虑多情损道行，入山又恐负深情！我不能眼睁睁看着你落下修炼啊！

121160.en: {relation|A|B}, is there some grand story that made you such an esteemed cultivator?
121160.ch: {relation|A|B}，您从前是不是有什么奇遇以致现在修为不凡？

121161.en: {relation|A|B}, there is much I need help with in my studies!
121161.ch: {relation|A|B}，我有许多修道的疑难想要请教！

121162.en: Your {relation|B|A}, I, has indeed much to ask you, {relation|A|B}.

121180.en: I have made a number of breakthroughs recently. I'll be sure to do all I can for you, {relation|A|B}.
121180.ch: 如今修为屡有突破，可以好好孝敬{relation|A|B}您了。

121181.en: {relation|A|B}, you've always been ready to drop everything for me. It's time I showed my gratitude!
121181.ch: {relation|A|B}从前对我照顾无微不至，现在正是我报答之时！

121182.en: {relation|A|B}, your prowess far exceeds your {relation|B|A} I!

121200.en: {relation|A|B}, your have already reached such heights?
121200.ch: 原来你的修为已经这样高明了么？{relation|A|B}

121201.en: Practically in the blink of an eye, you've broken through this far. I never saw it coming, {relation|A|B}!
121201.ch: 仿佛只是眨眼之间，没想到{relation|A|B}却已突破到这个地步。

121202.en: Excellent, excellent. I see my constant instructions were not in vain. You've mastered this better than even your {relation|B|A}.
121202.ch: 甚好，甚好，真不枉我屡屡指点，你的修为上的造诣已经超越{relation|B|A}了。

121220.en: With your {relation|B|A} to shield you, none will dare challenge you!
121220.ch: 在{relation|B|A}庇荫之下，绝无人敢动你！

121221.en: There is much of this path that you've come to understand of late. Would you want your {relation|B|A} to guide you?
121221.ch: 最近于道法多有领悟，可要{relation|B|A}指点于你？

121222.en: You can always count on your {relation|B|A} to care for you!

121240.en: My {relation|C|B} has always cared for me, so I'd like to gift {gender2|C} a {item} to show my gratitude.
121240.ch: {relation|C|B}对我多有照料，所以我将{item}送给{gender|C}算是一点心意。

121241.en: They say it's the thought that counts, but I'm hoping my {relation|C|B} will appreciate the {item} just the same.
121241.ch: 虽说物轻情意重，但我还是希望我{relation|C|B}能喜欢{item}这件礼物。

121242.en: I put careful thought into this {item}, and I'm sure my {relation|C|B} will be over the moon about it.
121242.ch: {item}是我悉心准备的礼物，相信{relation|C|B}收到后会十分高兴。

121260.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, mentioned the {item} to me previously, and now I'm gift it to {gender2|C}. Surely it will come as more than a pleasant surprise.
121260.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}上回给我提及{item}，现下我将此物赠送给{gender|C}，想必他一定大为高兴。

121261.en: Once I give the {item} to my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, {gender|C} might even gift me something in return.
121261.ch: 不知我将{item}赠送{relation|C|B}{name|C}后，{gender|C}会给我回个什么东西呢？

121262.en: All the same, the {item} is a mere gift, and I'm sure {name|C} will accept it without issue.
121262.ch: {item}不过是件小礼物，{name|C}当可安心收下。

121280.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has always been fond of the {item}, and so I'm going to gift it to {gender2|C}.
121280.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}对{item}始终心心念念，所以我就将此物送与{gender|C}。

121281.en: {name|C} has often comforted me, and to express my feelings as a {relation|C|B}, I thought a {item} would make a great gift for him.
121281.ch: {name|C}时常慰问我，看在{relation|C|B}一片心意的份上，我将{item}送给他了。

121282.en: {name|C} really is a caring person, so I'm going to gift him a {item}.
121282.ch: {name|C}真是个有心人，所以我将{item}送给他了。

121300.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} praises me for my respectfulness as a student, and has gifted me a {item} for my efforts.
121300.ch: {relation|C|B}{name|C}夸我尊师重道，因为这个原因，便将{item}送给我，算作奖勉。

121301.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} has always cared for the younger generations, and just recently gifted me a {item}.
121301.ch: {relation|C|B}{name|C}总爱关怀后辈，就在不久前才将{item}送给我。

121302.en: {name|C} gives me gifts every few days. Just yesterday, {gender|C} gave me a {item}. I'll never forget how fortunate I've been because of my {relation|C|B}.
121302.ch: {name|C}总是隔三岔五的给我送东西，也就昨天，{gender|C}又给我捎来{item}，此后我也会铭记{relation|C|B}给我的好处。

121320.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} really is good to me, and even gave me a {item} just recently.
121320.ch: {relation|C|B}{name|C}对我实在不错，之前还特意将{item}送给我了。

121321.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} gave me a {item}. I'm so happy I don't know what to say.

121322.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} gave me a {item}. To be honest, {gender|C} could've given me a blade of grass and I'd still be over the moon.
121322.ch: {relation|C|B}{name|C}将{item}送给我了，其实{gender|C}就是给我一根草，我也承情。

121340.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has always been caring towards me. Recently {gender|C} even gave me a {item}.
121340.ch: 我{relation|C|B}{name|C}总对我关怀慰问，不久前{gender|C}就将{item}送给我。

121341.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, gave me a {item}. Of course, I'm very happy about the gift, but what could be better than {gender|C} kindness toward me?
121341.ch: 我{relation|C|B}{name|C}将{item}送给我了，东西确是好物，但是哪比得上{gender|C}对我的心意呢？

121342.en: {name|C} has given me gifts every few days. What more could I ask for when my {relation|C|B} is like this?
121342.ch: {name|C}总隔三差五的给我送东西，有{relation|C|B}如此，更有何求？

121360.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, does seem to love {item}s, which inspired me to go searching for one.
121360.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}竟如此喜欢{item}，乃至向我索要此物。

121361.en: I've known for some time that {relation|C|B} {name|C} loves {item}s this much. I'd better offer one myself, but how to make {gender2|C} want one from me?
121361.ch: 早知{relation|C|B}{name|C}如此喜爱{item}，我就该亲自将东西奉上，怎能让{gender|C}向我要呢？

121362.en: {relation|C|B} {name|C} seems to want a {item} from me. I guess {gender|C} really does love {item}s.
121362.ch: {relation|C|B}{name|C}竟向我索要{item}，原来{gender|C}这么喜欢{item}么？

121380.en: {name|C} came to me asking for a {item}, given that {gender|C} wants one so much, I decided to give {gender2|C} one.
121380.ch: 之前{name|C}找我讨要{item}，看在{gender|C}十分中意拿东西的份上，我便将东西送给{gender|C}了。

121381.en: {name|C} is but my {relation|C|B}. For {gender|C} not to seek out a coveted item and come to me for it instead...!
121381.ch: {name|C}不过是我的{relation|C|B}，{gender|C}喜欢什么却不知道自己争取，只知道找我索要！

121382.en: {name|C} is my {relation|C|B}. If {gender|C} wants a {item} from me, how can I be so mean as to refuse?
121382.ch: {name|C}是我{relation|C|B}，{gender|C}既找我要{item}，我当然不会吝啬。

121400.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, wants a {item} from me. My concern is that if the younger generation knows only how to demand from others, how will they look after themselves?
121400.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}找我讨要{item}，但我觉得小辈若是养成随意索取的性子，日后只怕不易自立。

121401.en: I am fond of my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}. If {gender|C} wants a {item} from me, what sense is there in refusing?
121401.ch: 我对{relation|C|B}{name|C}十分喜爱，{gender|C}向我要{item}，这哪有不给的道理呢？

121402.en: Recently me {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, requested a {item} from me, and so I gave {gender2|C} one then and there.
121402.ch: 早些时候{relation|C|B}{name|C}向我讨要{item}，我当场就送给{gender|C}了。

121420.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has always been loving toward me. If {gender|C} wants a {item} from me, naturally I would not refuse.
121420.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}对我宠爱有加，我找{gender|C}要{item}，果然就给了。

121421.en: Every time I ask {relation|C|B} {name|C} for something, {gender|C} obliges without issue. It's like I can have whatever I want.
121421.ch: 每回向{relation|C|B}{name|C}索要物品，{gender|C}绝无不允，真可谓予取予求。

121422.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C} is most generous. {gender|2} never refuses me anything.
121422.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}为人一向大方，我向{gender|C}要东西从来没有不允许的。

123017.ch: 坦白说，世俗人情于我眼中什么都不是。你最好赶紧消失。不然{name|C}也救不了你。

123018.en: Being my {relation|C|B} should be enough for {name|C}. Why even bother with a lowlife like you?
123018.ch: {name|C}与我结成{relation|C|B}就够了，何苦又跟你这样的废物走在一起？

123019.en: I used to think {name|C} was one in a million. If they become your {relation|A|C}, I will definitely think less of {gender|C}.
123019.ch: 原本我觉得{name|C}是八荒中为数不多，能入我法眼的人。不想却与你结成了{relation|A|C}，这样一来就叫我有点看不起{gender|C}了。

123020.en: You really know how to hide, {call|B|A}. I guess it took a Heaven-chosen like me to prize you out of your hole.
123020.ch: {call|B|A}，你一向懂得东躲西藏，这八荒中也只有我这种天骄才能置你于死地吧？

123021.en: I thought you would come to a sticky end, {call|B|A}. I can't believe you're still alive, to be honest.
123021.ch: {call|B|A}啊，原以为似你这样的人品早晚要遭天罚，没想到苟活至今啊。

123022.en: Still not dead yet, {call|B|A}? I'll have to make some time in my busy schedule to take care of you, once and for all.
123022.ch: {call|B|A}，你竟然还没死？看来待以后我了去身上琐事还要会一会你啊。

123023.en: Enjoy the time you have. Who knows when I'll feel the urge to pound you into a pulp.
123023.ch: 你可要好好珍惜接下来的日子了，毕竟我哪天心血来潮，可能就要将你打成肉泥呢。

123024.en: There's no difference between good and evil in my mind, {call|B|A}. There's nothing I won't do. You should learn to keep your distance.
123024.ch: {call|B|A}啊，我眼中没什么是非正邪的区别，因此什么都能做。下次你看见我可要躲远一些。

123025.en: I might not be a {post|A}, but what would you know? You haven't seen the things that I have seen, and maybe you never will.
123025.ch: 蝼蚁啊，你{post|A}的身份虽然较我为高，可你见识有限，怕是永远看不见我眼中所见。

123026.en: It is not the realm you attain, but the openness of one's mind that determines the final outcome. Not that I'd expect you to understand that.
123026.ch: 境界高低不过一时雄长，胸怀眼界才是决定一个最终成就的条件。不过以你资质是悟不到的了。

123027.en: Do you dread the day when my cultivation will surpass your own, {name|A}?
123027.ch: {name|A}啊，你怕不怕有朝一日修为被我超越？

123028.en: Enjoy the time you outrank me, {name|A}, because from the day I surpass you will never know a moment of peace.
123028.ch: {name|A}啊，趁我眼下修为不如你，快快享受几天安乐时光吧。否则我一旦突破瓶颈，定会让你永无宁日。

123029.en: I can do anything I set my mind to, including besting you, and then... heh heh.
123029.ch: 我想做的事情就一定能做到。包括超越你，然后……嘿嘿。

123030.en: I don't pay attention to empty titles. If you insult me, you know what to expect.
123030.ch: 我从不将宗门虚位放在眼里。你若冒犯于我，照样搬你脑袋。

123031.en: No one feels guilty when they crush an ant between their fingers. You get me?
123031.ch: 一个人将蝼蚁捏死，心中是没什么负担的。你懂个我意思么？

123032.en: I'll give you a few days to write a will and find a new home for your kids, before I kill you.
123032.ch: 我可以给你几天时间，备好遗书，安顿家小，再来报复你。

123033.en: I fear the moment I raise my hand against you, you will crumble into dust, robbing me of the pleasure of vengeance.
123033.ch: 我真怕扬手之间，你就化成了灰，这样连一丝半点报复的快感也感受不到啊。

123034.en: As the Heaven-chosen, it is only a matter of time before I become the next {post|A}. Enjoy it while it lasts.
123034.ch: 以我天骄之资，居于要位不过迟早之事，好好珍惜近日身居{post|A}的日子吧。

123035.en: {name|A}, have you ever wondered why you are more accomplished than I am, but I still outrank you?
123035.ch: {name|A}，你有没有想过为何修为强于我，却仍然屈居我下？

123036.en: {name|A}, you have been overlooked, and that is why you will always be a minor character in the Sect.
123036.ch: {name|A}，天骄的所见你是无缘目睹了，这也是为什么你于门中始终是个卑微的角色。

123037.en: As the Heaven-chosen I am bound to be promoted. You, on the other hand, are destined to remain where you are for the rest of your days.
123037.ch: 门中以我身为天骄可堪造就，所以屡有提拔。至于你，这一辈子就安分地待在这个职位上吧。

123038.en: Characters like you are of minor interest and easily forgotten.
123038.ch: 你这种在宗门中可有可无的角色，有时候很容易叫我遗忘的。

123039.en: The future glory of the Sect depends on me. Some might even rub off on you.
123039.ch: 日后光大宗门的必然是我，至于你即便有几分

123040.en: Why would I use my rank to bully YOU?
123040.ch: 我根本不屑凭借自己宗门职位来为难你。

123041.en: Huh, I totally forgot you existed.
123041.ch: 噢，我都几乎忘了。门中还有你这号人物。

123042.en: A {grade|A} {post|A}? What is the point of you?
123042.ch: 身居{post|A}却只有{grade|A}的修为，你可真是个无能之人。

123043.en: The Sect only cares about Heaven-chosen. Why would they bother promoting a country bumpkin like you?
123043.ch: 宗门理当重视天骄的，不然还会将你这样的凡夫俗子放上要位么？

123044.en: One day you're in the Sect, the next day you're under my control and no matter what you do, you can't escape!
123044.ch: 你一日在宗门之中，一日便在我掌控之下，无论如何也逃不出我的手掌心的！

123045.en: You good-for-nothing, {call|B|A}. How did they ever let you into the Sect?
123045.ch: {call|B|A}，你一无是处，当初是如何加入宗门的？

123046.en: We might not get along, but there's no way I'm going to expel you from the Sect. I enjoy kicking your butt too much.
123046.ch: 你我虽然并不和睦，但我绝不会将你逐出宗门的。毕竟你在门中一日，我便能随意蹂躏你一日。

123047.en: One day you're in the Sect, the next day you're under my control and try as you might, you cannot escape the dragnet!
123047.ch: 你一日在宗门之中，一日便在我掌控之下，想想怎么逃出这张天罗地网吧！

123048.en: Your mistake wasn't joining the Sect; it was offending me. Now you will never escape my control.
123048.ch: 你最错的不是加入宗门，而是得罪了我。你以后都逃不出我手掌心。

123049.en: I am not a forgiving person, {call|B|A}. You have offended me, and now you will pay the price.
123049.ch: {call|B|A}，我就是一个心胸狭窄之人，你得罪了我，永远没有好日子过。

123050.en: Hasn't {school|A} taken you in hand yet? Appalling.
123050.ch: 似你这样肆意妄为的人，{school|A}竟没有出手整治你么？

123051.en: When I become the Heaven-chosen I will deal with you myself. {school|A} won't have to punish you.
123051.ch: 我身为天骄日后道法大成便亲手对付你，根本不必劳烦{school|A}惩罚你。

123052.en: Hm. Only a den of bandits like {school|A} would give shelter to the likes of you.
123052.ch: 哼，也只有{school|A}这种匪窝能容下你这样的宵小之辈。

123053.en: Your time is coming. When I finally breakthrough, my first opponent will be you.
123053.ch: 你不能一直嚣张下去的，毕竟我突破在即，到时八荒之中罕有敌手，第一个就对付你。

123054.en: You're accomplished and insult people with impunity, isn't that right? Unfortunately for you, this time you have insulted me, a Heaven-chosen!
123054.ch: 你境界不低，所以一直轻易得罪人是么？不过你这次没那么幸运，你得罪的我，乃是一名天骄！

123055.en: {school|A} cannot protect you now. You have offended me, a Heaven-chosen.
123055.ch: {school|A}保不住你的，毕竟你得罪的我，乃是一名天骄。

123056.en: If I decide to kill you, not even the whole of {school|A} will save you.
123056.ch: 我要对付你的话，{school|A}全宗来保护也别想留下性命。

123057.en: I love bullying people who are weaker than me. I don't really have much choice, given how strong I am.
123057.ch: 我最喜欢的就是欺负弱小，毕竟八荒之中也没几个人比我强。

123058.en: Thinking of leaving {school|A}? If not, I might have to open a can of whup-ass, and who knows who could get hurt?
123058.ch: 快快脱离{school|A}吧？否则我报复你时，道法出手，玉石不辨，恐怕你的同门亦难幸免。

123059.en: No one can protect you. Not even your Sect.
123059.ch: 没有人可以保住你的。包括你的宗门。

123060.en: {school|A} is a great sect. Why they took you in, I'll never know.
123060.ch: {school|A}确是八荒大宗，只可惜收了你这样的败类。

123061.en: {school|A} is a very impressive sect. I honestly have no idea why they took you on.
123061.ch: {school|A}能够入我法眼，理应是八荒名门。只是我万万不料他们竟然收了你这样的门人。

123062.en: It's ridiculous. How could {school|A} take you in?
123062.ch: 真是叫人大失所望啊，{school|A}怎么会将你收纳门下？

123063.en: In my opinion {school|A} is an excellent school, and I am a very harsh judge. Sadly their standards have fallen dramatically since you joined.
123063.ch: 以我目空一切的眼光，{school|A}仍然算得上八荒众人上上之选，只可惜最近掺入你这种败类。

123064.en: Amazing! If {school|A} is a bunch of flowers and you're a stinky cow pat, then it looks like somebody went and stuck a flower in dung.
123064.ch: 不可思议啊，{school|A}好比鲜花，你则类似牛粪，现在是一朵鲜花插在牛粪上了。

123065.en: If {school|A} is a broken stove, you are a wonky pot. In other words, a match made in Heaven.
123065.ch: 如果{school|A}是破灶，那么你就是歪锅，配作一处，果然十分般配。

123066.en: You joined {school|A} for their protection? Too bad. I hate {school|A} too.
123066.ch: 你加入{school|A}是寻求庇护么？没用的，除了讨厌你，我还讨厌{school|A}。

123067.en: I've been thinking about destroying {school|A}. But now you've joined up, I won't have to bother.
123067.ch: 我早就有心灭了{school|A}，正好你加入该宗，倒省了我一番手脚。

123068.en: I've been planning the destruction of {school|A} for a while, but now that you've joined up, I can't wait to get on with it {school|A}!
123068.ch: 原打算日后覆灭{school|A}的，没想到你加入此宗，这倒叫我有点迫不及待要杀上{school|A}。

123069.en: I hate all sects, but I especially hate {school|A} because you are a member!
123069.ch: 我一向蔑视宗门，不过我倒很关注{school|A}，因为这个讨厌的宗门里面还收留着你这个我讨厌的人！

123070.en: Sects are a total waste of time. One day I will become an immortal and destroy {school|A}. Then you'll be sorry.
123070.ch: 八荒诸多宗门不过土鸡瓦犬，他日我修成仙身，定要杀上{school|A}，重重的羞辱你。

123071.en: The advantages of joining a sect are only temporary. I'm free as a bird and will become a great cultivator in time!
123071.ch: 加入宗门不过得了暂时的好处，我自在逍遥，将来一般的能成为八荒高人。

123072.en: You haven't done much since joining {school|A}, have you? You just wait, one day I'll breakthrough and leave you in my dust!
123072.ch: 你加入{school|A}就只学到这个境界而已？看着吧，来日我一有突破，修为绝对比你高。

123073.en: You joined {school|A} because you're afraid of me, didn't you? Whatever. I could overtake you now, if I had a mind to do it.
123073.ch: 你加入{school|A}是因为害怕我吧？哼，也是。只要我愿意，现在马上就能超过你。

123074.en: You haven't made much progress since joining the sect. One day I'm going to catch you. Take good care of yourself, because I've got a score to settle with you...
123074.ch: 你加入宗门后一切进步就到此为止了。此后我修成定会迎头赶上，希望你保住性命好让我亲自找你算账。

123075.en: Only weaklings depend on sects for protection. Rogue Heaven-chosen like me dominate the landscape.
123075.ch: 只有弱者才会取依靠宗门，天骄如我，散修亦能叱咤八荒。

123076.en: {school|A} is massing an army of weaklings, like you.
123076.ch: {school|A}聚起来一群人的便是如你一样的弱者。

123077.en: You know what they say, "Birds of a feather flock together". A chicken like you will fit right in at {school|A}.
123077.ch: 物以类聚，人以群分。你这弱者跟{school|A}的人聚在一起真是再合适不过了。

123078.en: Hanging out with {school|A} is not going to help you.
123078.ch: 与{school|A}的人聚在一起，无助于提升自己。

123079.en: {call|B|A}, I'm not sure hanging out with {school|A} all day is going to make you any smarter.
123079.ch: {call|B|A}，终日跟{school|A}这群蠢材在一起有没有让你变得更蠢？

123081.en: In this world there are mountains and rivers and forests, and heroes, like me.
123081.ch: 八荒之中，除去山水土木，便只容得下强者，好比我。

123082.en: Hardly anyone ever makes an impression on me. I do have a vague recollection of you, however.
123082.ch: 一般而言，能让我记住样貌的人几乎没有。至于你，倒好像有点印象。

123084.en: Alas, the sky cannot cover the earth and the earth cannot carry its load. Nothing has value anymore.
123084.ch: 可叹，举天所覆，尽地所载，俱是俗物。

123085.en: I guess you must have something going for you, if the Master took you in?
123085.ch: 师父将你收入门下，想必你有什么过人之处吧？

123087.en: Hm. What does the Master see in you?

123088.en: Keep up the hard work, {name|A}. Otherwise you will fall too far behind me, and I will feel ashamed.
123088.ch: {name|A}，你可要努力上进，否则与我修为差得远了，是会让我蒙羞的。

123089.en: You can understand the Master's lessons, right?
123089.ch: 师父传授的东西，你可应该搞懂了吧？

123090.en: Why would {name|C} have anything to do with you?

123091.en: I have higher expectations than {name|C}. I wonder, will you be able to earn my approval?
123091.ch: 不妨告诉你，我的眼光比{name|C}更高，你会做到我认同的程度吧？

123092.en: {name|C} is a good judge of character. You are {gender|C} {relation|A|C}, but I don't think you've got anything going for you.
123092.ch: {name|C}眼光一向不错，{gender|C}与你结为{relation|A|C}，我却不觉得你有什么过人之处。

123093.en: Yeah, I remember you. You're my {call|C|B}'s {relation|A|C}.
123093.ch: 哼，我记得你。你便是我{call|C|B}的{relation|A|C}。

123094.en: Master, what was your name again?

123095.en: I've got a score to settle with {name|C}. You stay away from {gender|C}. Don't blame me, if you get caught in the crossfire.
123095.ch: 我迟早要与{name|C}清算恩怨，你最好离{gender|C}远些，否则遭了池鱼之殃，不要怪我没有及早提醒。

123096.en: {name|C} is little more dirt in my eyes. You don't care what happens to dirt, do you?
123096.ch: {name|C}在我眼中不过砖瓦泥尘，你大概不会对砖瓦泥尘抱有关心吧？

123097.en: Please advise {name|C} to leave immediately. I'm afraid of what I might do if {gender|C} doesn't.
123097.ch: 请你转告{name|C}，若手足不曾残废，不妨赶紧逃离，否则我一旦出手，恐怕{gender|C}要化为一滩酱泥。

123098.en: I have a score to settle with {name|C}. You wouldn't help{gender|C}, would you?

123099.en: You get on well with {name|C}, right? Please tell {gender|C}, I will be coming after {gender2|C} before long.
123099.ch: {name|C}与你感情不错吧？告诉{gender|C}，不久后我便要向{gender|C}出手寻仇了。

123100.en: I am very fond of {name|C}. Don't get any funny ideas.
123100.ch: 我与{name|C}情同手足，奉劝你不要动无谓的心思。

123101.en: {name|C} is my {call|C|B}. Please bury the hatchet with {gender|C}.
123101.ch: {name|C}是我的{call|C|B}。从今日起，放下你与{gender|C}的仇恨吧。

123102.en: I don't care what your problem is with {name|C}. If you seek revenge, I will not stand idly by.
123102.ch: 我不管你与{name|C}有什么恩怨，但你若对其报复，我绝不会袖手旁观的。

123103.en: I've got one thing to say to you—don't touch a hair on {name|C}'s head.
123103.ch: 我只说一句，别妄想找{name|C}报复。

123104.en: You've got a score to settle with {name|C}? Suddenly I'm curious to know which one of you is the strongest.
123104.ch: 你会找{name|C}报仇是么？我突然很想知道你与其哪个更强？

123105.en: How do you feel about me being Sect Leader?
123105.ch: 你觉得我来当宗主如何？

123106.en: You just wait. One day I shall become the rock upon which this Sect is built.
123106.ch: 看着吧，总有一日，我要成为门中砥柱，支撑大局。

123107.en: The way I see it, there is no you and me. There is only superior and inferior.
123107.ch: 依我看，除去你我。宗门之中由上而下，不过如此。

123108.en: I've learned many Sect secrets of late and am on the verge of breaking through. Just giving you a heads up.
123108.ch: 近日对门中心法领悟良多，相信不日便将突破。你，要被我追上了。

123109.en: I had no objections to you being {post|A}, but there are people in the Sect who feel you have been promoted above your ability.
123109.ch: 你当{post|A}原无不妥，但门中许多渣滓身居要位就叫人心生不忿。

123110.en: If you're having any trouble with your fighting or sorcery, you can always come and talk to me.
123110.ch: 若你于拳脚刀剑，风雷水火诸般道法存有疑难，都不妨来请教我。

123111.en: Huh, how did someone like you become {post|A}?
123111.ch: 哦，原来似你这般，便能当{post|A}？

123112.en: Hello. I want to be {post|A} too.

123113.en: What does it mean to you, to be members of the same sect?
123113.ch: 你说，同门究竟是什么意思？

123114.en: So you are the Sect {post|A}. What has that got to do with me?
123114.ch: 原来你是门中{post|A}，呵，但是宗门职位于我何有哉？

123115.en: You're quite good. The problem is the Sect Elders are blind and deaf to your talent.
123115.ch: 你的修为不差，怪只怪门中枢要耆老都是瞎子聋子。

123116.en: Impressive. The problem is one of moral fiber. If you actually had some, you would have been promoted long ago.
123116.ch: 你修为不俗，但心胸之中仍为仁义道德拘束，否则早已身居要职了。

123117.en: Hm, you have missed your calling. An early grave awaits those with no ambition.
123117.ch: 哼，似你资质原本不该居此职位。为人需有狂者胸次，才能脱颖而出，否则早晚要被埋没。

123118.en: I outrank you, but what of it? When I grow tired of it, you can have my place.
123118.ch: 你眼下宗门中职位虽不如我，但这有什么？宗门虚位，我当腻了便让与你。

123119.en: You might be a mere {post|A} now, but when I achieve total world domination, I'll let you manage a few Sects. How about that?
123119.ch: 你位居我宗{post|A}之位，实在太过屈才。不过没关系，日后等我成为八荒第一人手握大权之后，定要赏你几个宗门玩玩。

123120.en: I don't get out that much, but if I did, I'm sure I would become a legend!
123120.ch: 我留在宗门之中，不过因为未得机遇，倘若机缘一到，相信便能成为八荒之中的传说吧？

123121.en: {call|B|A}, the Sect is full of foul miasma... and I am a breath of fresh air.
123121.ch: {call|B|A}，宗门之中大都是浑浊不明的污水，似我这样的清流，只怕少见。

123122.en: You and I might be in same sect today, but one day I will become a household name and leave you far behind.
123122.ch: 今日你我虽同在一个宗门之中，不过总有一日我会脱颖而出，成为八荒中人人传颂的神话。

123123.en: You think the Sect will help us attain immortality?
123123.ch: 你说，宗门真能让我等飞升成仙么？

123124.en: From what I can see, sect members aren't all that.
123124.ch: 我看宗门众人，大多不过如此。

123125.en: If I can breakthrough this bottleneck, I will quickly overtake you.
123125.ch: 只要我悟通这重关节，很快便能追上你的境界了。

123126.en: Judging from your current rate of cultivation, it is only a matter of time before I overtake you.
123126.ch: 以你目前的修炼法子，被我追上不过是早晚的事情。

123127.en: Your sect teachings are lame. I'm going to catch up to you in no time.
123127.ch: 你的宗门秘传不过尔尔，相信我很快便能追上你的境界。

123128.en: No need to worry about me catching up to you, because it's an inevitability.
123128.ch: 不要害怕我会追赶上你的境界，因为那是必然的。

123129.en: I won't forget about you when I hit the big time. I'll make you an immortal with one wave of my hand!
123129.ch: 待我道法大成之日，一定不会忘了你。到时我抬手间便能将你渡成仙身！

123130.en: {call|B|A}, let's meet up at {school|B}, if that's okay.

123131.en: If you're not happy, come and join me. I just need a word with the guys in HR.
123131.ch: 呆得不顺，就来我这边吧。不过是我与门中招贤堂说一句的功夫。

123132.en: Your sect sucks. Join me, and one day you will be a celebrated hero!
123132.ch: 你的宗门不过尔尔，来我这边，他日必能在八荒之中扬眉吐气。

123133.en: {call|B|A}, someone of your ability will be welcome anywhere! When you tire of traveling, seek me out.
123133.ch: {call|B|A}，相信凭我超凡资质，去到哪出都能受到礼遇。闯荡八荒遇有不顺，不妨来寻我。

123134.en: They just keep promoting me. I think I'll be Sect Leader in no time!
123134.ch: 我这边的宗门对我屡有提拔，相信不久的将来我便能当上宗主了吧。

123135.en: It looks like you're struggling, {call|B|A}. You want me to lend you a few manuals from the sect library?
123135.ch: {call|B|A}，你的境界似乎久未突破，要不要我在门中取来几本秘籍给你参研参研？

123136.en: Most sects teach a load of nonsense, but {school|A} is the exception to the rule.
123136.ch: 这八荒之中，大多宗门都狗屁不通，不过你所在的{school|A}倒并不十分荒唐。

123137.ch: 你的宗门{school|A}在眼中还算有那么点意思。

123138.en: Your sect possesses some valuable teachings. Learn them well, and one day you will be second only to me.
123138.ch: 你的宗门道法秘传都算上乘，好好修炼，总有一日能成为仅次于我的存在的。

123139.en: I always thought sects were a bad idea. Too restrictive. A waste of talent. But if {school|A} has unearthed you, they can't be all that bad.
123139.ch: 我一向觉得八荒宗门大多禁锢人心，湮没良材，不过{school|A}能发掘到你，倒也不算太坏。

123140.en: There aren't many sects in this world that I despise, and even fewer I truly respect. Luckily your sect is one of those that I admire.
123140.ch: 八荒之中能让我看不起的宗门寥寥可数，至于能让我看得起的更是凤毛麟角，恰好你的宗门算是我看得起的。

123141.en: You should leave {school|A} at the first opportunity. You don't want to become collateral damage when I obliterate the place.
123141.ch: 请你尽早离开{school|A}，否则他日我灭去贵宗门户时，你也难免受池鱼之殃。

123143.en: You should be on your guard at {school|A}. Don't go mixing with them, or I'll end up hating you, just like I hate the others.
123143.ch: 你留在{school|A}必须时时警惕自己，不要与你宗门的人同流合污，否则我会像厌恶你的宗门一样厌恶你。

123144.en: I've got a good feeling about you, but I'm not going to sugar-coat it. Your sect is a den of iniquity.
123144.ch: 我对你观感不坏，但我也不能欺心。阁下宗门实在是个藏污纳垢的地方。

123145.en: The day is coming when I will your raid sect and smash the Council Hall to pieces. Just giving you a heads up, on account of our friendship.
123145.ch: 有朝一日，我会杀上贵宗，亲手将你们的议事大厅打成粉碎。看在你我略有交情，眼下先行告知，盼你到时知机躲避。

123146.en: Is there any point to joining a sect?
123146.ch: 加入宗门，是有什么好处么？

123147.en: {school|A} is renowned throughout the land, not that I put much stock in that.
123147.ch: 阁下的{school|A}闻名八荒，不过那一点虚名在我眼里也不过如此。

123148.en: As far as I'm concerned, most sects are filled with good-for-nothing drunkards. The thought of fraternizing with them makes me sick.
123148.ch: 于我而言，大多宗门里面充斥着无数酒囊饭袋，与这些人相处，会让我浑身不适。

123149.en: You don't need to join a great sect to become an accomplished cultivator. Look at me. I'm self-taught and I'm destined for greatness!
123149.ch: 修炼原本不必托身大宗，且看我自悟自修，来日一般的能成为八荒尖子。

123150.en: You are quite accomplished. Color me impressed. But sooner or later I'm going to overtake you and when I do I will laugh loudly in your face!
123150.ch: 阁下修为不差，叫我佩服。不过这只是暂时的，我迟早会突飞猛进，修成道法，笑傲群宗！

123151.en: What's the point of joining a sect with all its rules and regulations? Look at me! I'm as free as a bird, and well on my way to becoming Heaven-chosen!
123151.ch: 你加入宗门白白多了无数拘束，似我逍遥自在，不也修得一身道法，成为一方天骄？

123152.en: {name|A}, someone with your ability will never surpass me, even if you do join a sect.
123152.ch: {name|A}，以你资质，即使加入宗门也无法达到我这样的境界。

123153.en: As I see it, whether or not you achieve {grade|A} depends purely on your own ability and has got nothing to do with {school|A}.
123153.ch: 以我所见，阁下{grade|A}修为纯属凭自己资质悟性，与{school|A}并无无关系。

123154.en: I've been meaning to ask you, what is the point of joining a sect?
123154.ch: 一直想向阁下请教，留在宗门之中，究竟有何好处？

123155.en: If I visit {school|A} one day, I wonder what the disciples will make of me, a Rogue Heaven-chosen?
123155.ch: 若有朝一日，造访{school|A}。贵宗门人见我一名散修天骄会作何感想？

123156.en: Sects have a stifling effect on the spirit. You and I are Rogue Cultivators, as free as the birds. How much better off are we, than those poor fools inside their clan halls?
123156.ch: 宗门就是各拘束人性的地方。你我作为散修，逍遥自在，不比呆在那些砖瓦栋梁中来得快意？

123157.en: I've always envisaged myself joining a sect, but knowing me, I'd probably end up backstabbing the Sect Leader! Hahaha!
123157.ch: 我一直在设想自己身入宗门的情形，以我性子，恐怕到时会忍不住设法陷害宗主吧？哈哈哈哈哈！

123158.en: {call|B|A}, Rogue Cultivators like me are rarer than hen's teeth in this world.
123158.ch: {call|B|A}，似我一般的散修八荒之中只怕凤毛麟角。

123159.en: There's no point in joining a sect! Stick with me and you'll go places, my friend!
123159.ch: 加入宗门毫无益处，阁下与我一同散修，我保你成为八荒之中一方大能！

123160.en: I am curious to know what you would say if a sect offered you gifts to join them?
123160.ch: 我很想知道，若有宗门备好礼物聘你入门，你会作何反应？

123161.en: As a fellow Rogue Cultivator, you can probably teach me a few things worth knowing.
123161.ch: 同样作为散修，你还是有那么一点点东西值得我学习效法的。

123162.en: We might both be Rogue Cultivators, but in the end I intend to one of the Heaven-chosen.
123162.ch: 虽与阁下一般身为散修，但我最终是要成为八荒一代天骄的人。

123163.en: I never envy those who belong to sects. How about you?
123163.ch: 我从不羡慕宗门之人，阁下是否亦作此想？

123164.en: I admire your accomplishments. But even more impressive is the fact you have chosen a life of freedom on the road, like me.
123164.ch: 你的修为高我一筹固然可敬，更可敬的是你亦与我一般不入宗门自由自在。

123165.en: Look upon this turbulent and sordid world! How many Rogue Cultivators are there, like you and I, who can rise above it all?
123165.ch: 放眼八荒，滚滚浊流，不知如你我不染污泥的散修更有几人？

123166.en: I know Rogue Cultivators like to go it alone, but honestly, a snail would progress faster than you.
123166.ch: 虽说你散修并无其他助力，可你修行进境，也实在太慢了。

123167.en: If I didn't see some potential in you, I wouldn't give you the time of day.
123167.ch: 若非看在你身上颇有几分优点，以你这样的修为，我简直不想理你。

123168.en: You appear to have reached a bottleneck. Do you want me to show you some new moves?
123168.ch: 你修为达到瓶颈，要不要我给你点功法上的心得？

123169.en: Generally speaking, I hold my fellow Rogue Cultivators in high regard, but you really seem to be struggling. It will be quite embarrassing to be seen talking with you.
123169.ch: 我对同为散修的修仙之人抱有好感，可你修为始终难以突破，这样一来你我相处就会让我有点难堪。

123170.en: I might be better than you, but you put a lot of other people to shame! After all, the world is full of fools and cowards who aren't worth a damn.
123170.ch: 你的修为逊我一筹，可已比许多人来得厉害。毕竟放眼八荒，大都是蝼蚁微尘，不足一哂。

123171.en: I admire you, despite our differences. I'm not a bully, you know!
123171.ch: 我对阁下颇为赞赏，即使你我立场各异，亦可放你一马。

123172.en: Relax. I'm willing to spare anyone, as long as they're easy on the eyes.
123172.ch: 请放心，只要我看得顺眼，便是敌人也能饶过，你不会死的。

123173.en: I don't care about good and evil. As long as I get a good vibe from a person, I'll be their friend.
123173.ch: 我心中不存正魔之别，只要我觉得你为人不差，你便我的朋友。

123174.en: Good and evil, friend or enemy, I don't care about any of that.
123174.ch: 什么正魔敌我之别，我一向不放在眼中。

123175.en: Why speak of good? Why speak of evil? The world is full of well-meaning hypocrites and kind-hearted villains.
123175.ch: 何谓正？何谓魔？正者虚伪狡诈不在少数，魔者正直耿介亦所在多有。

123176.en: We might as well have a duel. I'm gonna catch up with you sooner or later.
123176.ch: 你我不妨比一比，我修为迟早会赶上你的。

123177.en: Do not judge me by what I can do now, friend. If I keep working hard, greatness awaits just around the corner!
123177.ch: 朋友，别看我眼下修为低微，只要我希望增进修为，白日飞升亦是指日可待。

123178.en: I really need a friend like you to look up to. It motivates me to keep going and working on improving myself.
123178.ch: 我就是需要你这样能够一直让我仰望的朋友，如此一来，我才能保持上进，自强不息。

123179.en: What I seek is to become a hero. C'mon buddy, you gotta be one too!
123179.ch: 我追求的是成为强者，我的朋友你也必须是强者。

123180.en: Pathetic weaklings on every side. I really had no choice but to make friends with you.
123180.ch: 周围那些孱弱不堪的人实在叫人讨厌，万般无奈下我便选了你当我朋友。

123181.en: Be honest with me, buddy, you think you're holding me back? Cultivate harder.
123181.ch: 朋友，实话说，你会不会觉得你成我累赘了？提升一下修为吧。

123182.en: You're such a weakling. I'm afraid the day is coming when I'll despise you, old friend.
123182.ch: 你这样弱，我怕有朝一日会嫌弃你啊，吾友。

123183.en: I intend to be the greatest cultivator of all time. If you plan to follow in my footsteps, we're going to be friends for a long time.
123183.ch: 在这八荒中呼风唤雨，才是我的目标。你要跟上我的步伐，那么我们这个朋友才做得长。

123184.en: I don't need friends, but I do like taking care of the weak and feeble-minded.
123184.ch: 我不需要朋友，但我喜欢照顾弱者。

123185.en: As I see it, brotherhood and betrayal go hand in hand. What do you think, buddy?
123185.ch: 在我看来兄友弟恭，最后都不离背离反叛。朋友，你以为呢？

123186.en: I'll do whatever it takes to beat you, {call|A|B}. How do you feel about that?
123186.ch: {call|A|B}，我会想尽一切办法超越你的，你看这样可好？

123187.en: Teach me everything you know, {call|A|B}. My cultivation will surpass your own.
123187.ch: {call|A|B}，请你将所有功法心得告诉我，我一定会比你获得更深厚的修为的。

123188.en: And what is "sibling rivalry", pray tell?
123188.ch: 敢问“兄弟阋墙”是什么意思？

123189.en: One day I will surpass you, but don't worry, I'll look after you.
123189.ch: 我修为一定会超越你的，到时便由我来罩着你。

123190.en: Amazing... What have you been eating, {call|A|B}? Magical fruit?
123190.ch: 难以置信……{call|A|B}，你定是吃了什么神妙丹药，奇异灵果吧？

123191.en: I despise weaklings, but I'll still look after you, {call|A|B}.
123191.ch: {call|A|B}，虽然我一向讨厌弱者，但是我会保护你的。

123192.en: To be the best, you gotta beat the best.
123192.ch: 我的志向是挑战八荒一切高手，成为八荒第一人。

123193.ch: 敢问”兄友弟恭“是什么意思？

123194.en: Don't be discouraged just because I'm better than you. It stands to reason.
123194.ch: 修为上略逊于我那是完全不必气馁的。毕竟我比你强也是情理之中。

123196.en: Poor is the pupil who does not surpass his master, don't you think?
123196.ch: 徒弟，超过为师，便是造次，你说呢？

123197.en: When I see your excellent progress, I can't help wondering to myself, when will you turn your hand against me? Haha.
123197.ch: 现今你比为师更强了，让师也不禁想，有朝一日，你会不会反扑为师呢？呵呵。

123198.en: You really are an excellent Apprentice. One day you and I will rule the world.
123198.ch: 果然是为师的好徒弟，日后八荒之中便是你我师徒间的天下了。

123199.en: Vexed is the master whose pupil surpasses him.
123199.ch: 其实将你教得青出于蓝，大非为师所愿啊。

123200.en: Since when did you get so powerful, Disciple? Huh?
123200.ch: 徒儿，敢问你是从何时起，变得如此厉害了？嗯？

123202.en: There is no place in the world for weaklings, Disciple. You cannot just do as you please.
123202.ch: 徒儿，八荒之中最容不下的便是弱者，你不能放任自流。

123203.en: Apprentice, it is better to kill another man, than to be killed by another man, that is to say... You know the deal. Take care of yourself.
123203.ch: 我的徒弟不能给别人杀死打败，与其让别人杀死打败，还不如……呵呵，为师有言在先，你好自为之吧。

123204.en: You are very accomplished, Disciple. I'd like to study your internal organs to see how you did it... Just kidding.
123204.ch: 徒儿，您修为高强，为师想要看看你体内脏腑内息行经线路。嗯，为师当然是说笑的。

123205.en: I think I might have taught you a little TOO well, Apprentice. What do you think we should be do about it?
123205.ch: 把徒弟你教得这么厉害，为师心中多少有点不安。徒弟你说怎么办呢？

123206.en: Master, will you always be more accomplished than me?
123206.ch: 师父，你的境界会一直比徒儿高吧？

123207.en: Master, how would you feel if one day I surpassed you?
123207.ch: 师父，如果徒弟有朝一日修为比你还高，你会作何感想？

123208.en: Can you clarify something for me, Master? Right now you're my Master because you are better than me. But when I surpass you, who will you be then?
123208.ch: 弟子有一事不明，今日师父之所以是弟子师父，乃是师父有一日之长。那么日后弟子比师父强大，师父又是弟子何人？

123209.en: Master, how is it you are still better than me? Could it be that you fear me, and are keeping secrets from me?
123209.ch: 师尊，以我资质如何至今仍然比不过你？可是你心怀忌惮，藏私不教？

123210.en: I am a great talent, Master. You wouldn't lead me astray, would you?
123210.ch: 弟子乃八荒中资质绝顶之人，师父不会教不好我吧？

123211.en: I am a great talent, Master. It stands to reason that I would surpass you.
123211.ch: 弟子乃八荒中资质绝顶之人，超越师父乃是情理之中吧？

123212.en: Master, my accomplishments have surpassed your own. Keep working hard and one day you might catch up.
123212.ch: 禀报师尊，弟子修为已经超越师父了。请师父努力磨砺，早日再有突破。

123213.en: I can't abide weaklings. I guess you feel the same way, Master?
123213.ch: 弟子最看不惯的便是弱者，师尊也是这样么？

123214.en: It appears my cultivation has surpassed your own. Would you like me to give you some pointers?
123214.ch: 师父修为已经比不过弟子了，要不要弟子将功法讲解说与你听？

123215.en: I have grown very powerful, Master. I will continue your work. Why don't you retire to the mountains and grow cabbages? It's a lot safer up there.
123215.ch: 弟子现今功法大成，师父后继有人，因此想请师尊寻一清幽之地安心归养，莫再踏足八荒这个凶险之地了。

123216.en: I won't have a change of heart, {call|B|A}. I invested so much time and energy in you. I wouldn't want to waste it.
123216.ch: {call|B|A}，我不会随意变心的，毕竟我都花了时间心机在你身上，这些可不能白白浪费。

123217.en: There's no difference between blush and bone, {call|B|A}. Falling out of love is commonplace. If one day you should grow tired of me, tell me straight.
123217.ch: {call|B|A}，红粉白骨，原本没什么区别。眷侣间反目成仇更是屡见不鲜。有朝一日忍受不了我，不妨直说。

123218.en: Beauty is best admired from afar. Everything loses its luster when viewed up close. What say you, {call|B|A}?
123218.ch: 美丽大都来自距离，站得近，看得真切，一切也就不美了。{call|B|A}，你以为呢？

123219.en: I'm an important person these days. I've got a lot on my plate, {call|B|A}.
123219.ch: {call|B|A}，我是八荒中的强者，实在有太多的事情要办了。

123220.en: I'm happy to go for walks and take in the scenery with you. But aside from that, I think it's better to keep our distance.
123220.ch: 你我闲时尽可揽月观花，踏山看水，除此以外，你还是不要太过了解我为好。

123221.en: I need to do more cultivation.

123222.en: ...? You're even more accomplished than I am.

123223.en: Hah! The only reason you're doing so well is because you're hanging out with me.
123223.ch: 哼，你是因为与我在一起，才会变得突飞猛进的……

123224.en: ...{call|A|B}, since when did you get better than me?
123224.ch: ……{call|A|B}，你的修为是从何时超过我的？

123225.en: I'm not upset that you are better than me. I prefer to take a longer term view of things.
123225.ch: 我不会因为你的修为比我高而不快，我的所求是更为长远的东西。

123226.en: {call|A|B}, I've organized a cozy cave for you to live in. The world is a very dangerous place. You're better off not going out.
123226.ch: {call|A|B}，为了保护你，我已寻得一处洞府让你栖身。八荒之中满是凶险，寸步难行，不适合你。

123227.en: {call|A|B}, I'm going to be a world famous Heaven-chosen. It's keeping me super busy. I just don't have time for you anymore.
123227.ch: {call|A|B}，我是要在八荒中闯出名堂的天骄，还有许多事情要处理。最近就只好冷落你了。

123229.en: They say two heads are better than one, but I say couples are forever bickering and wasting their breath. Booooring.
123229.ch: 常说二人计长，依我说，两人在一起，动辄意见相左，还要费去无数口舌，实在是无聊之极。

123230.en: {call|A|B}, who knows if those lovey-dovey couples really are happy, behind closed doors?
123230.ch: {call|A|B}，不知那些你侬我侬的眷侣间心中是不是真的充满快乐？

123235.en: {call|A|B}, I've organized a cosy cave for you to live in. The world is a very dangerous place. You'd better stay in.
123235.ch: {call|A|B}，为了保护你，我已寻得一处洞府让你栖身。八荒之中满是凶险，不适合你。

123238.en: Two heads are better than one, they say, but couples are forever bickering and wasting their breath. Booooring.
123238.ch: 世人皆言一人计短，二人计长，依我说，两人在一起，动辄意见相左，实在是无聊之极。

123240.en: You don't have to show your strength, {relation|A|B}. Just mention my name and the crowd will back away.
123240.ch: {relation|A|B}，即使不露出你的修为实力，只要报上我的名号，八荒中人都会退避三舍。

123241.en: Oh? {call|B|A} reaching {grade|A} is no skin off my nose.
123241.ch: 哦？以{call|B|A}{grade|A}修为倒也不至于辱没了我。

123242.en: {call|B|A} is very capable, but I'll catch up quickly.
123242.ch: {call|B|A}果然修为果然不凡，不过孩儿很快就会追上了。

123243.en: Only the ambitious succeed in this life. I cannot depend on {call|A|B}.
123243.ch: 这八荒之中，总要自强自立才能闯出名堂，我是不会依赖{call|A|B}的。

123244.en: {call|A|B} is very accomplished. I want to be like that one day!
123244.ch: {call|A|B}修为果然令人佩服，是孩儿追赶的目标啊。

123245.en: Are you getting old, {call|A|B}? How else do you explain falling behind?
123245.ch: {call|A|B}是不是老了？不然为何修为竟然落后了？

123246.en: I am stronger than you now, {call|A|B}. My day in the sun is not far away.
123246.ch: {call|A|B}，我的修为已经超越您了。相信孩儿在八荒中叱咤风云的日子不远了。

123247.en: {call|A|B}, one of these days I'll send my disciples to pay you their respects.
123247.ch: {call|A|B}，日后我要投在我门下的人一个个都来孝敬你。

123248.en: I don't usually pay much attention to others, but I won't soon forget {call|A|B}'s kindness.
123248.ch: 我一向目中无人，但{call|A|B}对我的恩情却叫我始终铭记于心。

123249.en: I am very accomplished now, {call|A|B}. If anyone offends you, just tell me, and I'll get someone to beat them up.
123249.ch: {call|A|B}，孩儿修为大成，自当负起保护您的责任，若有宵小冒犯不妨告诉我，我定要叫来人粉身碎骨。

123250.en: {call|A|B} is very capable, but I'll catch you soon enough.
123250.ch: {call|A|B}果然修为深湛，不过孩儿很快就会追上你。

123251.en: Today I'm proud of you, {call|A|B}... and one day I'll make you proud of me.
123251.ch: 今日我以{call|A|B}为荣，来日我在八荒之中大方异彩，便当由{call|B|A}以孩儿为荣了。

123252.en: I envy your skill, {call|A|B}. How do you feel about teaching me some of your secrets?
123252.ch: {call|A|B}一身修为道法让孩儿好生艳羡，不知{call|A|B}可愿将所有秘传教给孩儿？

123253.en: I envy your skill, {call|A|B}... but the day is coming when my own skill will shake the earth.
123253.ch: {call|A|B}一身道法好叫孩儿羡慕，不过孩儿相信有朝一日，也能创出属于自己的道法，成就一身大能。

123254.en: You are very powerful, {call|A|B}, but your knowledge all comes from the ancients. Can it really be considered "talent"?
123254.ch: {call|A|B}一身道法尽管威力无比，只可惜都是前人遗教。别无创建，终究算不得本事。

123255.en: {call|A|B}, when you're on the road, just mention my name and the crowd will part before you.
123255.ch: {call|A|B}，你行走八荒之际，只要报上我的名头，相信旁人无不退避三舍。

123256.en: Better keep a low profile, so you don't blacken my good name, {call|A|B}.
123256.ch: {call|A|B}，你平日最好谨言慎行，否则于我名声恐怕有所影响。

123257.en: It's survival of the fittest out there, {call|A|B}. If you want a place in this world, you will have to fight for it yourself.
123257.ch: {call|A|B}，八荒之中弱肉强食，你唯有自强自立，才能于众修仙者中间立住阵脚。

123258.en: Mark my words, if you become one of those hypocritical idealists, I won't hold back.
123258.ch: 记住{call|B|A}的话，万勿学那满口仁义道德虚伪小人，否则可别怪我辣手惩罚。

123259.en: If you stop progressing, {call|A|B}, I won't spare the rod. I'm not cruel... The world is fuel of ruthless people. A taste of my rod is nothing compared to what they will do to you.
123259.ch: {call|A|B}，修为若是停滞不前，我便出手鞭策。莫怪{call|B|A}狠心，八荒之中多是心狠手辣之辈，被我鞭策惩罚总好过被他人鱼肉蹂躏。

123260.en: It's not that I'm supercilious. There is just nothing out there worthy of my interest.
123260.ch: 不是我一贯目中无人，而是放眼八荒，并无能入我法眼的东西。

123263.en: Talking to commoners is such a waste of time. Don't you think so, {call|B|A}?
123263.ch: 与凡夫俗子说话，简直是浪费时间。{call|B|A}，以为然否？

123264.en: The weak depend on the strong. That's how it is, in Heaven and on Earth.
123264.ch: 弱者依附强者，天下之间，莫不如此。

123401.ch: ……（对方向你行了礼，而后便离开了。）

123402.ch: ……（对方向你微微鞠躬，而后便离开了。）

123404.en: I've heard so much about you.

123405.en: ... (They nod and smile, then walk away)
123405.ch: ……（对方向你颔首微笑，而后便离开了。）

123406.ch: ……（对方对你点了下头，而后便离开了。）

123407.en: I have traveled for many years. Few people impress me, but you are among them.
123407.ch: 在下行走八荒多年，鲜有人让我高看一眼，你倒是一个。

123408.en: Don't obsess about breaking through. Just get out there and test yourself and sometimes fortune will strike.
123408.ch: 不必总是挂念着突破境界，试着多外出试炼有时也能遇到机缘。

123409.en: You can't expect everything to always go your way. Just do your best.
123409.ch: 阁下不必凡事都求尽人意，只要无愧于心就好。

123410.en: I used to run around everywhere, always worrying about breaking through, but looking back I realize, time is precious.
123410.ch: 从前我只顾着突破境界而不停奔波，如今回头看才发现，往昔的岁月实在令人怀念。

123411.en: I sometimes wonder, do people who betray their friends and family just to get their hands on artifacts and manuals, end up all alone? I mean, what's the point?
123411.ch: 我常常思索，那些为了法宝秘籍而背叛亲友的人，最后落得孤身一人的下场，究竟是为哪般。

123412.en: I used to look down on common people because I was raised to be the Chosen One. Later I discovered the quiet life is actually quite nice.
123412.ch: 从前我总觉得凡人不过蝼蚁，因为我生来就是天之骄子。可后来我发现，没有尔虞我诈的生活，实在温馨。

123413.en: We belong to the same sect. If you run into trouble with your practice, feel free to come and ask me for help.
123413.ch: 你我既是同门，若是修行遇到难处，你也可来求助于我。

123414.en: No matter where you are in the land, the sect has got your back.
123414.ch: 不管你在八荒何处，师门都是你坚强的后盾。

123415.en: Relax. As long as I'm around, no one is going to cause you any trouble!
123415.ch: 放心，既然有我在，就决不允许有人欺辱你！

123416.en: If you get into a tight spot, remember to drop the Master's name. Nobody wants to piss off {name|C}.
123416.ch: 危急关头，记得报上师父的大名，想必不会有人想要招惹到{name|C}。

123417.en: {name|C} mentioned you. Seeing you today, I see your reputation is well deserved.
123417.ch: {name|C}曾向我提起你，如今一见，果然名不虚传。

123418.en: You're just like {name|C} said, well worth getting to know.
123418.ch: 你倒是像{name|C}说到的那样,值得结交.

123419.en: You don't realize, {call|B|A}, just how many people turn on each other over matters of treasure and lore. That's why I place so much value on our friendship.
123419.ch: {call|B|A}，你所有不知，正是因为我见过不少人因秘宝功法而反目，所以才格外珍惜你我之情。

123420.en: Rogue Cultivators might be footloose and fancy free, but there's something to be said for the sense of security you get belonging to a sect.
123420.ch: 虽说散修的确自在，但这种被宗门庇护的感觉确实不错。

123421.en: I always felt a bit lonely on the road. Joining {school|B} has given me a real sense of belonging.
123421.ch: 从前孤身一人闯荡八荒，总觉有些孤单。如今加入了{school|B},倒也有了归属感。

123422.ch: 若是非我宗之人与你攀谈，切记不可轻信。

123423.en: Always hold your tongue in the presence of new friends.
123423.ch: 你且谨记，防人之心不可无。

123424.en: Do not be boastful on the battlefield or underestimate your enemy, no matter how weak or poorly armed he is.
123424.ch: 战场上，切忌自大，万不可低估任何一个对手。

123425.en: You are an exceptional talent. Beware you do not take the wrong path.
123425.ch: 阁下如此出类拔萃，切勿走上歪路。

123426.en: Fighting monsters is the sacred task of Heaven-chosen like us!
123426.ch: 我们同为天骄之子，更应为斩妖除魔贡献力量！

123427.en: Those of us on the Demonic Path are unrestrained by mundane conventions. I admire the way you follow your heart.
123427.ch: 我魔道中人，何须受世俗的桎梏，在下很欣赏你的随心而为。

123428.en: You will be a great asset to the Demonic cause!
123428.ch: 有你加入，我们的魔道发扬光大指日可待！

123429.en: {school|A} isn't a very good sect. Why don't you consider going somewhere else?
123429.ch: {school|A}实在并非好的宗门，阁下何不考虑另寻去处?

123430.en: Sect life has its advantages, but I am used to being alone. I don't like being told what to do.
123430.ch: 虽说加入宗门大有益处，但我向来孤身惯了，不愿意受约束。

123431.en: I hate being told what to do. I'd rather the freedom that comes with being a Rogue Cultivator.
123431.ch: 我向来不愿受约束，还是做个散修自在快活。

123432.en: I enjoy a sense of security as much as the next person, but for some reason I haven't found a suitable sect yet. Is the same true of you?
123432.ch: 有时我也体验一番被庇护的感受，奈何还未遇到合心意的宗门，阁下也是如此吗？

123433.en: I guess lots of sects must be fighting over someone of your ability.
123433.ch: 想必像阁下这般大能，定是有不少宗门争相抢夺吧。

123434.en: Cultivation isn't something you can achieve on your own. You need to talk to others and learn from their experience.
123434.ch: 修行并非闷头苦练之事，也要常与人交流心得。

123435.en: Socializing, chatting with friends, getting into debates is all well and good, but I always feel a bit deflated afterwards.
123435.ch: 虽说常与好友相聚，三五成群，高谈阔论。可喧嚣过后总觉得有些落寞。

123436.en: It's a dog-eat-dog world out there, Disciple, survival of the fittest. Remember, if you do not wish to die at the whim of another, to cultivate yourself with perseverance.
123436.ch: 这八荒世界就是这样，弱肉强食，强者为尊。徒儿你且记住，若不想自己的生死被掌握在他人一念之间，只有不断的修炼，永不停歇。

123437.en: Disciple, when you decided to take the Path of Cultivate, there is no turning back. The road is filled with adversity and you must cut your own way through.
123437.ch: 徒儿，当你决意踏上修仙之途，就已注定无法回头。你只有一路披荆斩棘，才能从亿万修仙者中厮杀而出。

123438.en: I used to practice by myself and traveled a long and winding road. Luckily I have a Master now, and have left all of that behind me.
123438.ch: 从前徒儿总是自己修炼，走了不少弯路。幸好如今有师父的指导，让我不必那么艰辛。

123439.en: You used to protect me Master, but now that I have grown in ability, I can protect you!
123439.ch: 从前是师父您来保护我，现如今我已成长起来，就让我来保护师父您吧！

123440.en: People always told me you were not right for me, but I never listen to hearsay. I always knew you were the best of the bunch.
123440.ch: 总有人告诉我，你并非佳配，但我从不认同这些流言蜚语，因为我始终坚信你就是那个最好的人。

123441.en: Sometimes I reach a bottleneck and feel discouraged... but then I remember you're there, and it gives me the strength to go on.
123441.ch: 有时修行遇到瓶颈，难免有些苦闷。可一想到有你陪着我，就又有了继续前行的动力。

123442.en: Keep working out, so one day we'll be able to stand in front of all our friends and family, a match made in heaven.
123442.ch: 你可要快些变强，届时便能同你携手告诉所有亲友们，我们乃是天作之合。

123443.en: The longer we're together, the more I realize our feelings are hard-won.
123443.ch: 越是与你在一起的久，便越发觉得我们的感情来之不易。

123444.en: ... (They take one look at you, then turn and walk away)
123444.ch: ……（对方瞥了你一眼，直接转身离开了。）

123445.en: ... (They take one look at your face, then rush off, looking troubled)
123445.ch: ……（对方看了一眼你的容貌，而后紧皱眉头迅速离开了。）

123446.en: ... ({name|B} stares at you with red eyes, the turns suddenly and walks away)
123446.ch: ……（{name|B}双眼通红的瞪着你，而后扭头离开。）

123447.en: You just wait. I will have your head, one of these days!
123447.ch: 你且等着，我早晚会取了你的项上人头！

123448.en: You must have a death wish, to show your face around here.
123448.ch: 活腻了吗？还敢出现在我面前。

123449.en: Well, well, look what the car dragged in. Give me one good reason not to crush you like an ant.
123449.ch: 你这废物还敢出现在我面前，你可知我动动手指就能捏死你。

123450.en: Empty vessels make the most noise.

123451.en: Leave if you want to live.

123452.en: I will spare you this time, on account of our sect connection. But don't blame me if you screw up again.
123452.ch: 看在你是我同门的份上，我且先留你一命。但你若再不知好歹，可就不要怪我不客气了。

123453.en: The reputation of {school|A} was built on the backs of our disciples. But you scum have brought dishonor to our name with your antics!
123453.ch: 我宗弟子，辛辛苦苦立下{school|A}的威信。而你等小人，竟四处为虎作威，实在败坏我宗名誉！

123454.en: ... ({name|B} glares at you angrily, but doesn't make a move)
123454.ch: ……（{name|B}对你怒目而视，却不敢上前有所行动）

123455.en: Don't make me unleash the power of {school|B}, Cultivator. I really don't want the bother of cleaning up afterwards.
123455.ch: 这位道友，你可别逼我动用{school|B}中的势力，我并不愿掀起一场腥风血雨。

123456.en: ... ({name|B} sneers at you, then turns and walks away)
123456.ch: ……（{name|B}对你冷笑一声，就转身离开了）

123458.en: You might have joined a good sect, but I'll just wait and see how far you can scurry.
123458.ch: 不过是入了个好宗门，我且看你能横行到几时。

123459.en: A word of advice. Rogue Cultivators should stay in their lane. Don't write checks with your mouth your body can't cash.
123459.ch: 在下奉劝你一句，散修就该有散修的样子，你没有向我叫嚣的资本。

123460.en: Pathetic Rogue Cultivators have got no one to back them up. You must have a death wish or something.
123460.ch: 区区散修，无人庇护，还敢到我面前嚣张。可是活腻了？

123461.en: I spared you last time. You must have a death wish to show your face around here again.
123461.ch: 上次我大发慈悲，饶你一命。如今还敢来我面前叫嚣，莫不是存心找死？

123462.en: Back for more, Chicken Little? What a waste of space you are.
123462.ch: 逃战之人还有脸皮出现我面前？我可真是瞧不起你。

123498.en: It's a dog eat dog world out there, Disciple, survival of the fittest. Remember, if you do not wish to die at the whim of another, to cultivate yourself with perseverance.
123498.ch: 这八荒世界就是这样，弱肉强食，强者为尊。徒儿你且记住，若不想自己的生死被掌握在他人一念之间，只有不断的修炼，永不停歇。

125001.en: Your aura can be felt from quite a distance, and close by your charisma stands out even more. I knew it must be you, {appellation|A}.
125001.ch: 远观阁下就气宇非凡，近看更是卓尔不群，原来是{appellation|A}。

125002.en: It was a great honor for me to talk with you today, {appellation|A}.
125002.ch: 今日竟能与{appellation|A}交流心得，在下荣幸至极。

125003.en: I've long heard about your achievements, and today I finally get to meet you, {appellation|A}!
125003.ch: 我早已听闻你{appellation|A}的事迹，今日可算见到本尊了。

125005.en: So you are {appellation|A}! It is an honor to meet you!

125006.en: {appellation|A}, it's such a pleasure to know you.

125007.en: {appellation|A}... You're indeed a promising disciple! I'm so pleased with you!
125007.ch: {appellation|A}……不错不错，你果然是可塑之才！为师倍感欣慰。

125008.en: It must be my karma in my past life that made me your disciple today, {appellation|A}.
125008.ch: 我想定是我前世造的福，今日才能拜入{appellation|A}您的门下。

125009.en: My son, now that you are a {appellation|A}, you will surely have a bright future.
125009.ch: 吾儿能成为{appellation|A}，想必日后定大有造化。

125010.en: {appellation|A}, with your guidance, I will surely proceed with my cultivation with more ease. I'm so lucky!
125010.ch: 有您这{appellation|A}的庇护，想必我日后的修仙之途也能更为畅通无阻，真好！

125011.en: {call|B|A}, you're {appellation|A} now, and I'm so happy for you.
125011.ch: {call|B|A}，你如今乃堂堂{appellation|A}，我由衷的替你感到开心。

125012.en: Becoming {appellation|A} will bring you a lot of benefits, but also envy from some petty minds. {call|B|A}, take care while traveling in the wild.
125012.ch: 虽说你成为{appellation|A}有无限益处，但免不了有人眼红。{call|B|A}，你在外历练时还是要注意安全。

125013.en: I've always been thinking highly of you, and you proved yourself by achieving {appellation|A}.
125013.ch: 我一直都很看好你，你果然取得了不小的成就，这{appellation|A}便是最好的证明。

125014.en: It's great you've become {appellation|A} now. You've always been the best among all my Partners!
125014.ch: 你能成为{appellation|A}真是太棒了，你果然是我所有道侣中最厉害的那个！

125015.en: {relation|A|B}, since you became {appellation|A}, many friends of mine expressed their jealousy of me!
125015.ch: {relation|A|B}，自从你成为{appellation|A}，有诸多好友对我羡慕不已！

125016.en: It's such an honor for me, {school|A}, to have a {appellation|A} friend like you!
125016.ch: 我{school|A}有你这{appellation|A}的存在，大家都非常引以为荣！

125017.en: Don't think you can have your way at everything just because you are {appellation|A} now.
125017.ch: 你别仗着自己是{appellation|A}，就为所欲为。

125018.en: You are {appellation|A} now? Not bad. But don't think you can mess with me just because of that. I'll still wipe you out without hesitation!
125018.ch: 你是{appellation|A}？倒还有点本事。不过，你若是将我惹恼了，我照杀无误！

125201.en: {appellation|A}, you're always so humorous. It's really a pleasure to talk with you.
125201.ch: 不愧是{appellation|A}，果然说话风趣幽默，让人感到舒心。

125202.en: So you are the {appellation|A}. Could you teach me something some day?
125202.ch: 原来你就是{appellation|A}，改日传授我些其中的门道可好？

125203.en: You're such a humorous person. No wonder people like you.
125203.ch: 阁下如此风趣幽默，实在让人忍不住心生好感。

125204.en: You have so many Partners! You're really something!
125204.ch: 阁下竟能有如此之多的道侣，佩服佩服！

125205.en: Somehow, you feel quite different than others, and it's very relaxing to be with you.
125205.ch: 不知为何，感觉阁下有种与旁人不同的气质，让人莫名倍感舒适。

125206.en: A relationship might be a distraction from cultivation, but since you are {appellation|A} now, you might have considerations beyond love. Go ahead, and I'll follow you.
125206.ch: 虽说耽溺于情爱不利于修行，但你既已是{appellation|A}，或许能有另一番机缘，那便随你去吧。

125207.en: Dawn or dusk, whatever I see reminds me of you.
125207.ch: 晓看天色暮看云，行也思君，坐也思君。

125208.en: It's my greatest luck to meet you in this vast world.
125208.ch: 于八荒世界中遇见你，应就是我此生最大的幸运。

125209.en: Like father, like {relation|A|B}! You're a natural charmer just like me!
125209.ch: 不愧是我的{relation|A|B}，像为父一样风流。

125210.en: Like mother, like {relation|A|B}! You're a natural charmer just like me!
125210.ch: 不愧是我的{relation|A|B}，像为母一样风流！

125211.en: Now that you are {appellation|A}, you will surely have a bright future.
125211.ch: 阁下如今已是{appellation|A}，想必日后定大有作为。

125212.en: Your win streak in the Open Challenge Match really impressed me.
125212.ch: 阁下能在擂台赛连胜数场，在下实在佩服不已。

125213.en: I felt your aura from even miles away. I knew it must be you, {appellation|A}.
125213.ch: 在下不及你十里，就已感到威风凛凛之势，真不愧是{appellation|A}。

125214.en: So you are the world-famous {appellation|A}! You have always been my model!
125214.ch: 想不到你正是威名在外的{appellation|A}，在下仰慕你已久！

125215.en: Thank you for sharing your experience in Open Challenge Match with me. I learned a lot.
125215.ch: 多谢阁下传授我擂台赛的经验，在下实在收益颇多。

125216.en: So you are... {appellation|A}! Please forgive me for my ignorance and snub just now.
125216.ch: 阁下竟是……{appellation|A}！恕在下方才有所怠慢，还望阁下切勿放在心上。

125217.en: Now that you are {appellation|A}, you will be a mainstay of our {school|B}. As long as you stay in our Sect, we will do our best to satisfy your needs.
125217.ch: 你既是{appellation|A}，那日后便是我{school|B}的栋梁之材。你只要愿意一直留在我宗，我宗必不会亏待你。

125301.en: I really hope I'll be rich enough to be generous like you one day.
125301.ch: 真希望有一日，我也能像你这般出手阔绰。

125302.en: I wonder how you made such a fortune. Could you teach me how to earn some Spirit Stones?
125302.ch: 不知阁下是如何赚得如此盆满钵满，可愿带着我一同赚取灵石？

125303.en: Everyone knows your title of Benefactor Deity and your generosity with Deity Stones. We really envy you!
125303.ch: 谁人不知你散财天尊的名号，大手一挥便是巨额灵石，实在是羡煞旁人。

125304.en: You were so generous with your money the other day, and I really envy you.
125304.ch: 阁下前些时日一掷千金可谓潇洒至极，在下实在艳羡不已。

125401.en: You do have a unique sense with clothing. You look even more handsome in your outfit today.
125401.ch: 阁下的眼光真是独具慧眼，此身装扮衬得你更为风度翩翩。

125402.en: You do have a unique sense with clothing. You look even more beautiful in your outfit today.
125402.ch: 阁下的眼光真是独具慧眼，此身装扮衬得你更为风姿绰约。

125404.en: {relation|A|B}, your outfit today is marvelous as usual.
125404.ch: {relation|A|B}今日这身装扮，还是如此气质超群。

125405.en: You're like a beautiful picture that pleases the eyes.
125405.ch: 你真像一幅优美的画卷，赏心悦目。

125501.en: You may have not realized, but your Taoist Title of {appellation|A} is the highest glory for us Rogue Cultivators.
125501.ch: 阁下有所不知道，您这{appellation|A}道号简直就是我们散修至高的荣誉。

125502.en: I know you can't join a Sect since you're {appellation|A}, but if you need a Sect one day, we {school|B} will always welcome you.
125502.ch: 虽然我知道你作为{appellation|A}不能加入宗门，但倘若有一日你需要宗门的庇护，我{school|B}永远欢迎你。

125503.en: You're a noble {appellation|A}, yet you kept bullying other Rogue Cultivators. Don't you feel ashamed?
125503.ch: 你贵为{appellation|A}，却屡屡欺辱其他散修，你扪心自问对得起你这道号吗？

125516.en: I am very impressed by how deeply you have studied the art of alchemy.
125516.ch: 阁下竟能将炼丹之术研究的如此深入，在下十分佩服。

125517.en: I'm sure it must have taken many years of hard work to become {appellation|A}.
125517.ch: 想必阁下也是苦练了多年炼丹之术，才能成为{appellation|A}。

125518.en: As expected from {appellation|A}, you're very knowledgeable about this.

125519.en: I realized from our exchange today that there is much learning to be done in elixirs.
125519.ch: 今日与阁下交流，才知原来丹药之中竟也如此大的学问。

125520.en: So you're {appellation|A}, I've heard a lot about you.

125521.en: I am very grateful that my disciple is able to leave a mark in the art of alchemy.
125521.ch: 吾徒能在炼丹之术上有所建树，为师十分欣慰。

125522.en: Master, you are {appellation|A}, so you must often need to forge pills. But please don't forget to forge some for your disciples.
125522.ch: 师父您乃{appellation|A}，想必常常需要炼丹吧，可别忘记给徒儿炼制一些哦。

125523.en: This is great. Since you have already become {appellation|A}, you now have an additional means of protecting your life.
125523.ch: 如此甚好。你既已是{appellation|A}，日后也便能多一个保命的手段。

125524.en: {appellation|A}, with your protection, my future cultivation will become smooth sailing, how great!
125524.ch: 有您这{appellation|A}的庇护，想必我日后的修仙之途也能更为畅通无阻，真好！

125525.en: {call|B|A}, you have become {appellation|A} now and I am sincerely happy for you.
125525.ch: {call|B|A}，你如今乃堂堂{appellation|A}，我由衷的替你感到开心。

125526.en: Although becoming {appellation|A} will bring you endless benefits, it will inevitably bring out the jealousy of others. {call|B|A}, you must not get caught off-guard when training in the open.
125526.ch: 虽说你成为{appellation|A}有无限益处，但免不了有人眼红。{call|B|A}，你在外历练时还是要注意安全。

125527.en: I've always thought highly of you and you did not betray my expectations with your achievements. {appellation|A} is the biggest proof of this.
125527.ch: 我一直都很看好你，你果然取得了不小的成就，这{appellation|A}便是最好的证明。

125528.en: It's great that you have become {appellation|A}. You really are the best amongst all my partners.
125528.ch: 你能成为{appellation|A}真是太棒了，你果然是我所有道侣中最厉害的那个！

125529.en: {relation|A|B}, ever since you've become {appellation|A}, there has been many friends who are envious of me!
125529.ch: {relation|A|B}，自从你成为{appellation|A}，有诸多好友对我羡慕不已！

125530.en: It is an honor for {school|A} to have a {appellation|A} such as yourself!
125530.ch: 我{school|A}有你这{appellation|A}的存在，大家都非常引以为荣！

125531.en: Don't think that you can do whatever you want just because you've become {appellation|A}.
125531.ch: 你别仗着自己是{appellation|A}，就为所欲为。

125532.en: So what if you have become {appellation|A}? Since you dare to mess with me, I hope you've prepared enough elixirs to perform a body reconstruction.
125532.ch: 你是{appellation|A}那又如何？既然敢来招惹我，就多备些丹药准备重塑肉身吧。

125533.en: I am very impressed that you have studied the art of forging so deeply.
125533.ch: 阁下竟能将炼器之术研究的如此深入，在下十分佩服。

125534.en: I'm sure you must have practiced forging for many years to become {appellation|A}.
125534.ch: 想必阁下也是苦练了多年炼器之术，才能成为{appellation|A}。

125536.en: I realized from our exchange today that there is much learning to be done in forging artifacts.
125536.ch: 今日与阁下交流，才知原来炼制法宝竟也如此大的学问。

125538.en: I am very grateful that my disciple is able to leave a mark in the art of forging.
125538.ch: 吾徒能在炼器之术上有所建树，为师十分欣慰。

125539.en: Master, you are {appellation|A}, so you must often need to forge artifacts. But please don't forget to forge some for your disciples.
125539.ch: 师父您乃{appellation|A}，想必常常需要炼制法宝吧，可别忘记给徒儿炼制一些哦。

125549.en: So what if you have become {appellation|A}? You still can't beat me even if you had ten more artifacts.
125549.ch: 你是{appellation|A}那又如何？多给你十个法宝也照样打不过我。

140001.en: Allow me to pay my respects, honored {call|B|A}!

140003.en: What a joy to catch a glimpse of you here today, {call|B|A}!
140003.ch: 今日一睹{call|B|A}您的风采，弟子真乃三生有幸！

140004.en: The destiny of {schoolName|A} rests on your broad shoulders, {call|B|A}.
140004.ch: 我{schoolName|A}未来命数，全要仰仗{call|B|A}您之威势。

140005.en: {schoolName|A} basks in the glory of your presence, {call|B|A}. May you stand astride the world and never fall!
140005.ch: 我{schoolName|A}幸有{call|B|A}您坐镇，必能屹立八荒，万年不倒！

140006.en: {call|B|A}, you are a true talent and the envy of us all.
140006.ch: {call|B|A}您真乃八荒才俊，羡煞我等一众弟子也。

140007.en: If I had half your talent, {call|B|A}, I could leap over the Dragon Gate and thumb my nose at the world!
140007.ch: 弟子若得{call|B|A}您半分天资，定能鱼跃龙门，傲视群雄！

140008.en: If you have time, {call|B|A}, would you mind teaching us some of your moves?
140008.ch: {call|B|A}您若有闲暇，还望多多垂训我等弟子。

140009.en: If only you would teach me, {call|B|A}, I could die without regret.
140009.ch: 若有幸得{call|B|A}您的教诲，弟子死而无憾矣。

140010.en: It's my lucky day today! My fortune said I would meet you, {call|B|A}!
140010.ch: 弟子今日卜得大吉，原来是会与{call|B|A}您相遇，实在妙极。

140011.en: It is my great fortune to meet you today, {call|B|A}!
140011.ch: 得遇{call|B|A}，弟子今日实在造化不浅！

140012.en: You are a mainstay of the sect, {call|B|A}! I am a long time admirer.
140012.ch: {call|B|A}您德高望重，乃是宗门支柱，弟子早已仰慕多时。

140013.en: When I cast my eyes across the sects of this land, who compares to {call|B|A} of {schoolName|A}?
140013.ch: 放眼八荒各宗，何人可与我{schoolName|A}{call|B|A}您相提并论？

140014.en: Now that you are here, {call|B|A}, glory awaits {schoolName|A}!
140014.ch: 有{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}睥睨八荒，指日可待！

140015.en: Without you, {call|B|A}, I fear the glory of {schoolName|A} would not be what it is.
140015.ch: 若无{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}怕是远无今日荣光。

140016.en: The best thing about being a {school|A} Disciple is, I get to spend time with you, {call|B|A}.
140016.ch: 身为{school|A}弟子，最值得骄傲之事便是与{call|B|A}您身处同宗。

140017.en: The day is coming when the power of {schoolName|A} will extend as far as the eye can see, and it will all be thanks to you, {call|B|A}.
140017.ch: 有朝一日我{schoolName|A}登临八荒绝顶，必然依靠{call|B|A}您的扶持。

140018.en: In your absence, {call|B|A}, {school|A} would be lost, like a fish out of water.
140018.ch: 我{school|A}若离了{call|B|A}您，便如同出水之鱼，难以长久。
